test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. What is the number of dots on the face opposite to the one with four dots?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/352ee2348e71a742cf2a79d395f20d97ecfc3df9d7b2b4ba522b369d23e8000a.png]
solution:
Here, we are given two dices and both have a common face i.e. 4. 

So, we will rotate the 2nd dice such a way that the face 4 will come in the same place as in 1st dice, as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61644740deed2ac069966f9c1ae0b3469e82f0343b12b2f96e93fe470cbd9ad4.png] 

Thus, we can see that, face 3 is opposite to face 4 as all the other faces numbers are shown except number 3.

 

Hence, there will be __**3**__ dots on the face opposite to the one with four dots.
